# Direct runtime dependencies, pinned to the exact versions that produced the
# committed artifacts (see versions.txt at the repository root).
#
# This file pins what the project imports. The full transitive closure that the
# image actually installs is exported after the first build into
# requirements.lock.txt, which is what the image is then rebuilt from and what
# environment_id hashes. Do not edit that file by hand.
#
# torch is installed from the CPU wheel index (see the Dockerfile): the default
# PyPI wheel carries a CUDA runtime this project never uses, and the CPU wheel
# keeps the image roughly a gigabyte smaller. There is no GPU in the evaluated
# environment, so nothing numerical changes.
